scope: same real sub-01 T1, isolated official FreeSurfer 8.2 N4 reference replay versus FNIT N4; official output never used by the candidate workflow
input: official and FNIT orig.mgz have identical 284-byte MGH headers and all 16777216 voxels; gzip bytes and non-image footer differ
interpretation: The same-host official replay reproduces the archived reference; FNIT N4 leaves two real voxel differences. The separate headcw replay also shows host-dependent N4 rounding, so cross-host bitwise comparisons cannot isolate the FNIT algorithm difference. This does not prove the two voxels are the only cause of later surface errors.
